title: Seoul questions ex-USFK commander's access to OPCON information
caption:
A public disagreement between a former USFK commander and South Korea's Defense Ministry has triggered a review of how sensitive military data is shared. The conflict centers on whether conditions for transferring wartime operational control have truly been met.
